newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB upbeat for 97 after good start.
newsitem.headline: WestLB upbeat for 97 after good start.

text.p: Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale (WestLB), Germany's largest publicly-owned regional bank, said on Tuesday it had a satisfactory start in 1997 and was upbeat for the full year.
WestLB said in its annual report that it planned to continue expanding its investment banking activities in 1997 and would also invest in risk management systems.

"The 1997 business year started satisfactorily for the WestLB group, we are confident about the further development," the bank said, adding that it expected business this year to show a continuation of the positive trend seen in recent years.
In 1996, group net profit rose 10.3 percent to 736 million marks ($431.7 million) from 667 million marks. Operating profit after risk provisions was up 10.6 percent at 1.39 billion marks.
The group balance sheet total rose to 470.8 billion marks from 428.6 billion.
